Request a demo Read more Built for Today’s Complex Regulatory Landscape Regulatory change is outrunning the systems built to manage it. The average regulated institution tracks 200+ regulatory changes daily across jurisdictions. Most compliance programs still run on spreadsheets, niche tools, and individual analyst memory, with no central, current, queryable view of every obligation the business is subject to. Meanwhile boards, regulators, and auditors are tightening the bar on how AI is governed inside the program. Archer Evolv™ Compliance closes both gaps on one platform: 50+ AI Operators turn regulatory change into governed action with full lineage from regulation to control to evidence. Monitor regulatory change with AI Operators Deploy AI Operators that scan 4,500+ regulatory sources across 170 jurisdictions and 40 languages, filtering 600+ daily changes down to what is material to your business and your jurisdictions. Build one master obligation library AI Operators parse regulatory and corporate content, version it, and link it into one master obligation library. Calibrated confidence on every extraction. 95% accuracy after expert review, compared with about 70% for generic LLMs. Identify gaps and align controls AI gap analysis detects conflicts and proposes resolutions, not just alerts. Controls auto-map continuously from obligation to evidence with full lineage and versioning. The result is a control environment that stays current as regulation moves. Run the program on one platform Unify regulatory change management, policy authoring, control mapping, and assurance on one platform with one audit plane. Reduce redundancy. Close gaps. Pass exams without findings. Lower the total cost of compliance Early adopters report 40 to 60 percent reduction in operating costs, 40 to 60 percent increase in research capacity, and 20 to 40 percent reduction in regulatory change cycle times. AI Operators monitor 4,500+ regulatory sources across 170 jurisdictions and 40 languages, ingesting 600+ regulatory changes a day. They extract obligations with calibrated confidence, propose resolutions when controls do not align, and emit a structured audit record on every action. The result is a compliance program that is defensible to a regulator, the board, and internal audit. Can Archer Evolv Compliance replace my existing compliance tools? Yes. Archer Evolv Compliance unifies regulatory intelligence, obligation management, control mapping, policy alignment, and audit evidence on one platform. It runs standalone or as a seamless extension of any existing Archer GRC installation, on-premises or SaaS. No migration is required. How is the AI in Archer Evolv Compliance different from generic AI agents? Archer Evolv Compliance is powered by AI Operators, not generic AI agents. Operators are identity-bound, scope-constrained, audit-emitting, expert-supervised, and provider-independent. Every action emits a structured audit record with actor, intent, model, inputs, outputs, calibrated confidence, and justification. Extraction accuracy is 95% after expert review, compared with about 70% for generic LLMs. What outcomes do customers report? Early adopters report 40 to 60 percent reduction in compliance operating costs, 40 to 60 percent increase in research capacity, 20 to 40 percent reduction in regulatory change cycle times, and typical payback under three years. PayPal deployed Archer Evolv Compliance across 15 countries and 2,100 users in seven months, with typical deployment in six weeks. Ready to get started? Bring the regulation you are working on.
